query:
UPDATE frecency_events
            SET was_processed = true
            WHERE id IN (
                SELECT id
                FROM frecency_events
                WHERE was_processed = false
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT $1
                FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            )
            RETURNING
                id,
                user_id,
                entity_type,
                event_type,
                timestamp,
                connection_id,
                entity_id,
                was_processed
